question.text: A client has high financial ability but low risk willingness. The PM should:

answer.text: Moderate risk exposure to willingness while educating on ability

explanation.text: The Logic: Willingness is the binding constraint — can't force clients into risk they're uncomfortable with. Education may raise willingness over time. The Trap: Forcing creates discomfort and potential regulatory complaints. Cross-Exam Context: X-A. Manager's Pro-Tip: Annual risk-profile re-assessment — willingness may evolve with experience.
